prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-44604
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-44604 for $194.08 USDC.

To settle this, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0xbbb4957aaff1275b51cf65c2bcbaa2cba5e87fa1. As always, this is the same address we’ve used for our previous transactions with you, so you can safely use your saved contact if you have it on file.

Once the payment is processed, our system will automatically update your account, and you’ll receive a confirmation receipt shortly. If you’ve already sent the payment, please disregard this email and consider it confirmed!

If you have any questions or need a copy of the original invoice, just reply to this thread or reach out to our accounts team at rowan-supply.example. We appreciate your business and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Best regards,
The Rowan Supply Billing Team
